notes: Golden expect fields use keyword must-include until an LLM judge exists. Exact scenario human recordings are not available under clean licenses; speech is TTS + CC0/synthetic noise beds.

scenarios.script: Hi. I have a flat tire on the roadside. The front passenger tire is completely flat. I have a spare in the trunk but I'm not sure how to use the jack safely.
How can I repair my glasses frame? The plastic arm on the left side cracked near the hinge. The lenses are fine. I need them for work tomorrow.
A baby bird fell out of its nest in my backyard. It is peeping under the oak tree. The nest is high up and I am worried about cats.
My kitchen sink is clogged. Water fills the basin and drains very slowly. I tried hot water. No chemicals yet. There is a garbage disposal.
I lost my car keys. Last place I remember having them is the grocery store parking lot about an hour ago. The spare key is at home across town.
Do I need to see a doctor? I cut my finger while chopping vegetables. It is still bleeding after ten minutes of pressure. It looks deep but I can move the finger.

Okay so the washing machine finished the cycle but the water is still sitting in the drum. It usually drains fine. I cleaned the filter last month I think. Brand is a Whirlpool front loader. Clothes are soaking wet and I have to leave for work. Is this a drain pump or a hose kink?

Wi-Fi died after I moved the router to the living room. Phones see the network name but cannot connect. The modem lights look normal. I rebooted twice. Ethernet to the TV still works. Maybe the password got reset? Or the five gigahertz band is broken?
My bike chain slipped off the front chainring while I was climbing a hill. I put it back on but it keeps skipping under load. The derailleur looks bent a little. I need to get home five miles away.

My neighbor's smoke alarm has been chirping for two days through the wall. I knocked once, nobody answered. I do not smell smoke. Should I call the building manager or the fire department? Apartment 4B I think.
I dropped my phone and the screen is cracked but it still works. Touch is fine except the top corner. No insurance. Is a screen replacement worth it or should I use a tempered glass cover for now?

Is this mold or just dirt? There are black spots on the bathroom wall near the shower. They wipe off a little but come back. The fan barely works. No smell of mildew that I notice, but I am worried about my kid's asthma.

So um the car — wait, first the tire looked low this morning, maybe flat, but then it started fine, then at the light it almost stalled, and I thought battery? Or alternator? There was a click yesterday. Also the check engine light blinked once then stopped. I am on the shoulder of Route 9. Spare is there. Jump pack is at home. Do I call a tow or try to limp to the gas station a mile away?

Okay I ate leftovers last night, maybe bad chicken, but also I have had this headache for three days, and my wrist hurts from typing, and now I feel dizzy when I stand up. Do I need urgent care or is it dehydration? No fever that I measured. My cousin said go to the ER but she always says that. The headache is behind my eyes.

The dishwasher error code is E24 — wait no, looking again it is E15. I thought it was a Bosch SHPM65 but the sticker says SHX878. Water pools at the bottom after a cycle. I already ran vinegar. Is this a drain hose or a circulation pump? Manual is online somewhere.

There is a fledgling on the ground again — wait the dog is barking — the nest fell partly after the storm. Kids are yelling. Is it safe to put the nest back in the tree or do I call wildlife rehab? The bird can hop but not fly.

I need to know if mold lets me break the lease. Landlord painted over spots last year. Now the closet smells musty and my throat is scratchy. I have photos. Also rent is late because of a job change which is a separate mess. What is the first step in this state?

Home EV charger keeps tripping the breaker when it hits twenty-four amps. Electrician said the panel is fine. Car is a used Bolt. Charger is a JuiceBox. Happens only after thirty minutes. Rainy today — related?
Eh my fridge no cold, freezer okay, maybe thermostat? Wait — also the ice maker stuck. Compramos this used last month. Do I replace the fan or the whole unit?
I am whispering because I am in a cafe. Someone stole my laptop bag from the chair when I ordered. Passport was inside. What do I do first — police or bank freeze?
The toilet is overflowing — no wait first the water heater is cold — also the breaker for the bathroom tripped. I shut the toilet supply. Kids in the tub. Which emergency first?

My oven will not heat above two hundred. Actually it does heat but the broiler is dead. Wait, the bake element glows. No — it does not. Model is from two thousand eighteen. Or twenty twenty. I never used self clean.
Um. Okay. So. The basement is flooding from the water heater relief valve. Water is an inch deep near the electrical panel. Main shutoff is stuck. I need steps right now.
My dog ate dark chocolate. Maybe two ounces of seventy percent. He is thirty pounds. Happened twenty minutes ago. He seems fine so far. Do I induce vomiting or go to emergency vet?
I locked myself out of my apartment. Keys are on the kitchen counter. Building manager office is closed until Monday. It is Friday evening. No spare with neighbors.
My garden hose burst at the spigot and water is spraying the foundation. I cannot turn the outdoor shutoff — the handle is stuck. Indoor valve location unknown.
I need to renew my passport for a trip in six weeks. The photo rules confuse me. Can I use a booth photo? Also my name changed after marriage and I am not sure which forms.
Power has been out for eight hours. Fridge was full. Freezer still has ice crystals. What food is safe and when do I throw things out?
